about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice C): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Mango Lassi Smoothie Bowl with Cardamom Granola
recipes.summary: Thick mango and yoghurt smoothie bowl topped with crunchy cardamom granola and toasted coconut flakes.
steps: Blend the mango, yoghurt, milk and half the cardamom for 1 minute, until thick and smooth, scraping down twice.
Spoon into two chilled bowls and smooth the tops.
Toast the coconut and oats in a dry pan for 3 minutes, until golden and fragrant.
Toss with the remaining cardamom and scatter over the bowls.
Drizzle with the honey and eat straight away.
notes: Add a splash more milk if your blender struggles.
Use dairy-free yoghurt for a no-dairy bowl.

recipes.title: Green Mango and Spinach Smoothie Bowl
recipes.summary: A bright green bowl of mango, cucumber and spinach blended thick and topped with seeds and fresh apple.
steps: Blend the mango, spinach, cucumber, yoghurt and apple juice for 1 minute, until completely smooth and thick.
Pour into two bowls and smooth the tops.
Arrange the sliced apple on top.
Scatter over the pumpkin and sunflower seeds and finish with the honey.
notes: Use fully frozen mango for the thickest texture.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Jar Oats with Honey and Grated Apple
recipes.summary: Creamy jar oats soaked overnight in milk with peanut butter, grated apple and a drizzle of honey.
steps: Stir the oats, milk, yoghurt, grated apple and cinnamon together in a bowl until combined.
Divide between two jars and cover.
Chill overnight or for at least 6 hours, until the oats are soft and the mixture has thickened.
Warm the peanut butter and honey for 15 seconds, then swirl over the top.
Finish with sliced apple.
notes: Keeps 3 days in the fridge without the apple on top.

recipes.title: Apple Pie Overnight Oats with Walnuts
recipes.summary: Soaked oats with grated apple, cinnamon and maple, topped with toasted walnuts for a cold apple pie breakfast.
steps: Mix the oats, milk, maple syrup, cinnamon, nutmeg and half the grated apple in a bowl.
Spoon into two jars, cover and chill overnight, until thick and creamy.
Toast the walnuts in a dry pan for 3 minutes, until fragrant.
Top with the yoghurt, the remaining apple and the walnuts just before eating.
notes: Squeeze a little lemon over the grated apple to stop it browning.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake Overnight Oats
recipes.summary: Grated carrot, sultanas and warm spice soaked into oats, finished with a tangy ricotta topping.
steps: Stir the oats, milk, carrot, sultanas, cinnamon, ginger and 1 tbsp maple syrup together.
Divide into two jars, cover and chill overnight, until the oats are soft and plump.
Beat the ricotta with the remaining maple syrup until smooth.
Dollop onto the oats and scatter with the pecans.
notes: Walnuts work as well as pecans.

recipes.title: Bircher Muesli with Pear and Hazelnuts
recipes.summary: Classic Swiss soaked muesli with grated pear, apple and yoghurt, finished with toasted hazelnuts.
steps: Mix the oats and apple juice in a large bowl and leave for 10 minutes.
Stir through the yoghurt, grated apple, grated pear, lemon juice and cinnamon.
Cover and chill for at least 4 hours or overnight, until creamy.
Toast the hazelnuts in a dry pan for 3 minutes.
Serve topped with the sliced pear, hazelnuts and honey.
notes: Loosen with a splash of milk if it firms up overnight.

recipes.title: Cheese and Spinach Borek Rolls
recipes.summary: Crisp filo rolls filled with feta and spinach, brushed with yoghurt butter and baked until deeply golden.

items: 300g frozen spinach, thawed and squeezed dry

steps: Heat the oven to 180°C. Cook the onion in the oil for 6 minutes, until soft, then cool and mix with the spinach, feta, 1 egg and the pepper.
Lay a filo sheet down, brush with butter, spoon a line of filling along one long edge and roll tightly into a log.
Coil the log loosely into a round tin and repeat with the rest, brushing the filo with butter as you go.
Whisk the second egg with the yoghurt and pour over the top, then scatter with sesame seeds.
Bake for 30 minutes, until deep golden and crisp, then rest for 10 minutes before cutting.
notes: Food safety: bake until the egg filling is fully set and hot through.
Keep unused filo covered with a damp tea towel so it does not dry out.

recipes.title: Welsh Bara Brith Fruit Loaf
recipes.summary: A sticky Welsh fruit loaf with sultanas and currants soaked in orange juice, sliced and spread with butter.
steps: Soak the sultanas, currants, sugar and orange juice in a bowl for at least 6 hours or overnight, until plump.
Heat the oven to 160°C and line a 900g loaf tin.
Stir the egg, flour, spices and zest into the fruit until just combined.
Scrape into the tin and level the top.
Bake for 60 minutes, until a skewer comes out clean.
Cool in the tin for 15 minutes, then turn out and slice thickly.
notes: Food safety: bake until the centre is fully cooked and the skewer is clean, as the batter contains raw egg.
Keeps 5 days wrapped, and is excellent buttered.

recipes.title: Irish Soda Bread with Caraway
recipes.summary: A no-yeast Irish loaf with a craggy crust and soft crumb, flavoured with caraway and best eaten warm.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C and flour a tray.
Mix the flours, bicarbonate of soda, salt and caraway in a large bowl.
Add the buttermilk and honey and stir quickly with a fork until a shaggy dough forms, without overworking it.
Shape into a round on the tray and cut a deep cross in the top.
Bake for 15 minutes, then lower the oven to 200°C and bake for 25 minutes, until golden and hollow-sounding underneath.
Cool for 15 minutes before slicing.
notes: Best the day it is baked; toast leftovers.

recipes.title: Irish Boxty Potato Pancakes
recipes.summary: Pan-fried Irish potato pancakes made from raw grated and mashed potato, crisp outside and soft within.
steps: Squeeze the grated potato in a clean tea towel until very dry.
Mix the grated potato, mashed potato, flour, egg, buttermilk, bicarbonate of soda, salt and spring onion into a thick batter.
Melt a little butter in a frying pan over medium heat.
Fry spoonfuls for 4 minutes each side, until golden and cooked through, adding butter as needed.
Serve hot with more butter or alongside bacon and eggs.
notes: Food safety: cook until the pancakes are golden and set through the middle, as they contain raw egg.

recipes.title: Apple and Walnut Breakfast Bread
recipes.summary: Moist apple loaf with walnuts and cinnamon and a crackly sugar top, sliced thick and toasted with butter.
steps: Heat the oven to 170°C and line a 900g loaf tin.
Squeeze the grated apple lightly, then whisk it with the milk, eggs, butter and sugar until combined.
Fold in the flour, bicarbonate of soda, cinnamon, salt and half the walnuts until just mixed.
Pour into the tin and top with the remaining walnuts.
Bake for 55 minutes, until a skewer comes out clean.
Cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then turn out and cool before slicing.
notes: Food safety: bake until a skewer comes out clean, as the batter contains raw egg.
Slices freeze well.

recipes.title: Zucchini and Lemon Breakfast Loaf
recipes.summary: A tender loaf with grated zucchini and lemon, lightly sweet and perfect with ricotta or butter.
steps: Heat the oven to 170°C and line a 900g loaf tin.
Squeeze the zucchini in a tea towel to remove the extra water.
Whisk the eggs, oil, sugar, lemon zest and juice and yoghurt.
Fold in the flour, baking powder, salt and zucchini until just combined.
Scrape into the tin, sprinkle with the pepitas and bake for 55 minutes, until golden and a skewer comes out clean.
Cool in the tin for 10 minutes before slicing.
notes: Food safety: bake until a skewer comes out clean, as the batter contains raw egg.
Swap the pepitas for sunflower seeds if you like.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Spice Breakfast Loaf
recipes.summary: A soft pumpkin loaf with cinnamon, ginger and nutmeg, lovely toasted and spread with butter.
steps: Heat the oven to 170°C and line a 900g loaf tin.
Whisk the pumpkin, eggs, oil and sugar until smooth.
Fold in the flour, baking powder, spices and salt until just combined.
Pour into the tin and scatter with the pepitas.
Bake for 55 minutes, until a skewer comes out clean.
Cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then turn out to cool.
notes: Food safety: bake until a skewer comes out clean, as the batter contains raw egg.
Use canned pumpkin puree or roast and mash your own.

recipes.title: Swedish Cardamom Buns Kardemummabullar
recipes.summary: Soft enriched buns rolled with butter, sugar and cardamom, twisted into knots and sprinkled with pearl sugar.
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar, cardamom and salt, then add the warm milk, egg and softened butter.
Knead for 10 minutes, until smooth and elastic, then cover and prove for 1 hour, until doubled.
Roll the dough to a 40 x 30 cm rectangle, until about 5 mm thick, and spread with the filling butter, brown sugar and cardamom.
Fold into thirds, cut into 12 strips, twist each into a knot and place on lined trays.
Prove for 30 minutes, then brush with beaten egg and sprinkle with sugar crystals.
Bake at 220°C for 12 minutes, until deep golden.
notes: Food safety: the egg wash is baked hard at 220°C; cook until the buns are golden all over.
Freeze cooled buns for up to 2 months.

recipes.title: Finnish Pulla Cardamom Braid
recipes.summary: A glossy braided Finnish coffee bread, scented with cardamom and sprinkled with almonds and sugar.
steps: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar, cardamom and salt with the warm milk and 2 eggs.
Knead in the butter, then knead for 10 minutes, until smooth and elastic.
Cover and prove for 1 hour, until doubled.
Divide into three ropes, plait them, place on a lined tray and prove for 30 minutes.
Brush with beaten egg and top with the almonds and sugar crystals.
Bake at 190°C for 30 minutes, until deep golden and hollow-sounding underneath.
notes: Food safety: bake until golden and cooked through, as the egg wash and dough contain raw egg.
Delicious toasted with butter the next day.

recipes.title: Cambodian Kuy Teav Pork and Rice Noodle Soup
recipes.summary: A clear pork broth with rice noodles, minced pork and fresh herbs, the Phnom Penh breakfast soup.
steps: Simmer the ribs, water and onion for 35 minutes, skimming, until the broth is clear and the meat is tender.
Season the broth with the fish sauce and sugar.
Soak the noodles in hot water for 8 minutes until soft, then drain.
Fry the garlic and mince in a dry pan for 5 minutes, until cooked through at 75°C and lightly browned.
Divide the noodles, mince and bean sprouts between bowls and ladle over the hot broth with a few ribs.
Top with shallots, coriander, spring onion and a squeeze of lime.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork mince until 75°C in the centre with no pink inside, and keep the broth at a rolling simmer.
Add chilli and garlic vinegar at the table.

recipes.title: Japanese Shoyu Ramen Soup
recipes.summary: Clear soy broth with springy noodles, soft eggs, sliced chicken and spring onion.
steps: Simmer the chicken, water, ginger, garlic and onion for 35 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through at 75°C and the broth is savoury.
Lift out the chicken, shred the meat and strain the broth back into the pot.
Stir the soy sauce and mirin into the broth and keep it hot.
Boil the eggs for 6.5 minutes, cool in cold water, peel and halve.
Cook the noodles in boiling water for 3 minutes, until tender, and drain.
Divide the noodles between bowls, ladle over the broth and top with chicken, egg, nori, spring onion and sesame oil.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until 75°C in the thickest part, and boil the eggs until the whites are fully set; cook the yolks through if serving anyone vulnerable.
Reheat leftover broth to a rolling boil.

recipes.title: Japanese Kitsune Udon with Sweet Tofu Pockets
recipes.summary: Thick udon in a clean dashi and soy broth topped with sweet simmered tofu pockets and spring onion.
steps: Simmer the tofu pockets in 150ml of the dashi with 1 tbsp soy sauce, the sugar and 1 tbsp mirin for 8 minutes, until the liquid reduces and they are glossy.
Bring the remaining dashi, soy sauce and mirin to a gentle boil in a pot, until steaming and fragrant.
Cook the udon in boiling water for 3 minutes, until tender, then drain.
Divide the udon between bowls and pour over the hot broth.
Top with the tofu pockets, spring onion and white pepper.
notes: Pour the pocket syrup over for extra sweetness.
Check the dashi for fish if you need a vegetarian dish.

recipes.title: Indonesian Soto Mie Noodle Soup
recipes.summary: A turmeric and lemongrass chicken broth with egg noodles, bean sprouts and boiled egg.
steps: Blend the garlic, shallots, turmeric and coriander to a paste with a splash of water.
Fry the paste in the oil for 4 minutes, until fragrant, then add the chicken, lemongrass and water.
Simmer for 25 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through at 75°C, then shred the meat and season with the soy sauce.
Boil the eggs for 8 minutes, cool, peel and halve.
Cook the noodles in boiling water for 3 minutes and drain.
Divide the noodles, chicken, sprouts and egg between bowls, ladle over the broth and finish with fried shallots and lime.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until 75°C in the thickest part, and boil the eggs until the yolks are fully set.
Serve with sambal.

recipes.title: Sri Lankan Parippu Red Lentil Soup
recipes.summary: A comforting red lentil and coconut milk dhal-style soup scented with turmeric, curry spices and lime.
steps: Cook the onion and garlic in the oil for 5 minutes, until soft.
Add the spices and stir for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the lentils, tomato and water and simmer for 20 minutes, until the lentils collapse.
Stir in the coconut milk and heat for 5 minutes.
Season with the salt and lime juice, thin with water if needed and serve with rice.
notes: Keeps 4 days and freezes well.
Top with fried curry onions for extra crunch.

recipes.title: Egyptian Shorbet Ads Yellow Lentil Soup
recipes.summary: A silky Egyptian lentil soup with cumin and lemon, served with fried bread and extra lemon.
steps: Cook the onion, carrot and garlic in 1 tbsp oil for 6 minutes, until softened.
Stir in the cumin and turmeric for 1 minute.
Add the lentils and stock and simmer for 25 minutes, until completely soft.
Blend with a stick blender until smooth, then season with the lemon juice and salt.
Fry the bread cubes in the remaining oil for 4 minutes, until crisp and golden.
Serve the soup with the croutons and extra lemon.
notes: Add a splash of water if the soup thickens on standing.

recipes.title: Tunisian Lablabi Chickpea and Bread Soup
recipes.summary: A garlicky cumin chickpea broth ladled over torn bread and finished with harissa, olive oil and lemon.
steps: Drain the chickpeas, add to a pot with the water and simmer for 40 minutes, until soft.
Crush 4 garlic cloves with the cumin and salt into a paste and stir into the pot.
Simmer for 5 minutes more, then stir in the lemon juice.
Place the torn bread in four bowls.
Ladle over the chickpeas and broth.
Top with the harissa, capers, remaining finely sliced garlic and a generous pour of olive oil.
notes: Canned chickpeas work in a hurry: use 3 tins and simmer for 15 minutes.

recipes.title: Brazilian Black Bean Soup with Orange and Chorizo
recipes.summary: A smoky black bean soup with chorizo and a splash of orange juice, served with rice and a squeeze of lime.
steps: Fry the chorizo in the oil for 5 minutes, until crisp and the fat runs.
Add the onion and garlic and cook for 5 minutes, until soft.
Stir in the paprika, then add the drained beans, bay leaf and water.
Simmer for 50 minutes, until the beans are completely tender.
Mash a quarter of the beans against the side of the pot to thicken, then add the orange juice.
Season, simmer for 5 minutes, and serve with the coriander and lime.
notes: Food safety: cook the chorizo until 75°C in the centre and piping hot; boil dried beans for at least 10 minutes in fresh water before simmering.
Skip the chorizo for a vegan soup.

recipes.title: Sichuan Mala Chilli Oil
recipes.summary: A fragrant red oil with Sichuan pepper, chilli flakes and aromatics for dumplings, noodles and eggs.
steps: Toast the Sichuan peppercorns in a dry pan for 1 minute and crush coarsely.
Put the chilli flakes, crushed pepper, sesame seeds and salt in a heatproof bowl.
Heat the oil with the star anise, cinnamon, garlic and ginger over low heat for 8 minutes, until just bubbling around the aromatics.
Strain the hot oil over the chilli mixture and it will sizzle, then stir in the soy sauce.
Cool completely and store in a clean jar.
notes: Keeps 1 month in a cool dark cupboard.
Stir the oil before use so the chilli sinks to the bottom.

recipes.title: Mushroom Gravy with Thyme
recipes.summary: A rich vegetarian gravy of browned mushrooms, onion and thyme, ready for roasts, mash and pies.
steps: Cook the mushrooms in the butter in a wide pan for 8 minutes, until deeply browned and the liquid has gone.
Add the onion and cook for 5 minutes, until soft.
Stir in the flour and tomato paste for 1 minute.
Gradually whisk in the stock and soy sauce.
Add the thyme and bay leaf and simmer for 10 minutes, until glossy and slightly thickened.
Remove the herbs, season with the pepper and serve hot.
notes: Blend half for a smoother gravy.
Use cornflour instead of flour for a gluten-free gravy.
